title: A Community Standard Multispecies Cell Atlas of the Basal Ganglia.
organism: Homo sapiens, Macaca mulatta, Callithrix jacchus, Mus musculus
reason: Cross-species multimodal atlas of basal ganglia with multiple sequencing modalities and batch integration, highly relevant for integration benchmarks but no specific data accessions provided in this abstract.
methods_summary: Large-scale single-cell transcriptomic classification integrated with epigenomic and spatial genomic modalities, cross-species sampling, harmonized analytical frameworks, community-informed annotation, and standardized nomenclature.
